title: Every paid slate load prefetches three legal pages (12.6 KB, 4 background requests); landing/results/game prefetch /slate
persona: User on slow 3G (400 kbps, 400 ms RTT, 4x CPU)
steps: Load /slate?sport=nba on Slow 3G, list Fetch requests
expected: No speculative prefetch competing with the main content on a slow link
actual: NBA slate: 19 requests, 182 KB; 4 Fetch prefetches = 12.6 KB (/legal/terms 4.6, /legal/privacy 3.7, /legal/responsible-gambling 3.6 KB, plus another) from footer Links in default prefetch mode. /results and /game pages prefetch /slate?_rsc (1.8 KB). Not a flood (no game-link prefetching: all 76 game links use prefetch={false}), but pure waste on 3G and the slate prefetch of a paid route hits the server for logged-out users.
evidence: perf.js output byType Fetch n=4 b=12607
